title: Review of c46's hunting ecology on fresh seed 11 (256^2) with the matched twin and a fuel-cut fork: predators are free droplets that divide away from prey and the prey swing against a dividing twin emulsion, but E belongs to the prey and D to the predators
summary: Labkit re-run of the claim's world.py, defaults, seed 11, 256^2, t=12000, --lineage-k 5: prey 57 -> 3 (t~3400) -> 66 (t~5600) -> 20-25; predators 0 -> 57 -> 30-57; predators 23 persistent splits, generation 2; prey 2 persistent splits. strict_pred.png (splits3, area >= 10): 16 predator divisions, 5 with no prey within 6 px. freepred.py: 93% of predator bodies are > 2 px from any prey body; 12 of 17 divisions have a free parent, 10 with the parent > 6 px from prey, and in 16 both daughters are free 500 t later. Matched twin (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, window): prey 54 mean, 78 final, 23 persistent prey splits, 1 moving track. Fuel cut at t=6000 (128^2, labkit, seed 11) against its fed twin: prey bodies 17 -> 6 -> 1 -> 0 by t=6600 (fed 15-16), mean prey material 0.234 -> 0.229 (kept), predators unchanged (15 vs 12).

observations.S: rerun/seed11/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise in prey material over the whole box; predator noise over the whole box at t=2000
observations.I: free_s11.png: 93% of predator bodies are > 2 px from any prey body (rerun/seed11 sheet t=2600-12000: separate round, rod and Y-shaped droplets)
observations.X: rerun/seed11 vs twin/seed11 (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, K=5): prey 57 -> 3 -> 66 -> 20-25 with predators against 54 mean / 78 final without; prey persistent splits 2 vs 23. Sign: predators lower prey number and suppress prey division; predators need prey material (made from it)
observations.D: rerun/seed11/FACTS.md: predator 23 persistent splits, generation 2 (K=5); strict_pred.png 16 strict divisions; free_s11.json: 12 of 17 with a free parent, 16 with both daughters free at +500 t
observations.E: efork128 vs fed128 (seed 11, fork_t 6000): prey 17 -> 0 by t=6600 vs 15-16 fed, prey material kept (0.234 -> 0.229); this is the prey's E

seeds_run.result: pass: predator D (23 persistent splits, gen 2), prey swing, twin contrast, prey dissolve on fuel cut; prey D thin (2 persistent splits)

verdicts.limitation: The capabilities do not sit on one kind. The predators show I and D (free droplets dividing away from prey) but their E is by construction: they are made only from prey material, and the fuel cut leaves them untouched (15 vs 12 predator bodies). The prey show the dynamical E (they dissolve on a fuel cut with their material kept) but divide rarely with predators present (2 persistent splits on my seed, 23 in the twin), so D for the prey is thin. I list E as seen for the prey and put it in by_construction for the predators; the claim's same-individual IXDE is therefore not met. Predator persistent tracks are 0 (they dim between meals), and several strict 'divisions' in strict_pred.png are rods breaking while they dim. One seed; the fork at 128^2.
